data.title: Power Up the Plant Cell!
data.description: Help build a working plant leaf cell by picking the correct parts and leaving out the animal cell parts.

organelles.name: Nucleus
organelles.function: Controls all activities of the cell like a brain.
organelles.analogy: Like the principal's office of a school
organelles.quantityReasoning: A plant cell only needs one main control center to manage its daily instructions.

organelles.name: Mitochondria
organelles.function: Turns food into energy the cell can use.
organelles.quantityReasoning: Leaf cells need energy to run their normal living processes alongside making food.

organelles.name: Chloroplast
organelles.function: Captures sunlight to make food for the plant.
organelles.quantityReasoning: Leaf cells need lots of chloroplasts because their main job is to capture sunlight for photosynthesis.

organelles.name: Large Central Vacuole
organelles.function: Stores water and helps keep the plant upright.
organelles.analogy: Like a giant water storage tank
organelles.quantityReasoning: Plant cells use one large central water tank to stay firm and store hydration.

organelles.name: Cytoplasm
organelles.function: The jelly-like fluid that holds everything in place.
organelles.analogy: Like fruit jelly in a bowl
organelles.quantityReasoning: Fills the whole cell space to keep all the other parts afloat and connected.

organelles.name: Centrioles
organelles.function: Help animal cells divide and make copies.
organelles.analogy: Like construction workers building new rooms
organelles.distractorExplanation: Centrioles are typically found in animal cells, not plant cells.

functionMatches.functionDescription: Acts as the command center, holding the DNA blueprints that tell the cell what to do.
Breaks down nutrients to release usable energy for the cell's daily tasks.
Traps energy from the sun to build sugar molecules through photosynthesis.
Maintains water pressure inside the cell to keep leaves crisp and upright.
Provides a slippery, gel-like pathway for materials to move around inside.

cellMembrane.description: A flexible outer wrapping surrounding the cell.
cellMembrane.function: Controls what enters and leaves the cell, acting like a security gate.

cellWall.description: A tough, rigid outer layer that surrounds the cell membrane and gives the plant extra support.
